_note: Curated anatomy for /api/strongs — fieldy's own reading of what builds a name up. Keyed by Strong's number. parts: [{ sn, gloss }] in order (the literal building pieces, glossed in the app's own spelling); meaning: the pieces read as a sentence; def: the definition line, in the app's spelling. Anything here wins over the dictionary's derivation. Edit the file and the server picks it up on the next request (hot-reloaded by mtime) — no restart.
_rules: No Jehovah / Jah / the LORD / J-spellings anywhere — Yahawah, Yah, and the app's transliterations only (dictionary text is rewritten through name-map-expanded.json automatically; these entries are read as written).
Al = 'Alahay of Yashar-Al'; a gloss in (parentheses) after the piece; [brackets] for an alternative sense.
The joined transliteration stays the display form; hyphenation is decided by compound-hyphenation.json, not here.
